ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.

ElementDescription: Sex of subject at birth
Notes: M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Timepoint/visit label
Notes: e.g., Baseline, 6-Month Follow Up, Year 2; Morning, At Bedtime

ElementDescription: Elevated Mood Severity Rating Current  Severity
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Definitely Elevated; 3=Mood and outlook clearly out of proportion to circumstances

ElementDescription: Explosive Irritability Rating Current Severity
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Definitely Periods of Excessive irritability/anger; 3=Episodes of anger far our of proportion to stressor

ElementDescription: Decreased Need for Sleep Severity Rating Current Severity
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=At least 1/2 hour less than usual because of feeling energetic or high, at least two days consecutively; 3=At least 3 hours less than usual because of feeling energetic or high, and not tired

ElementDescription: Increased Energy Severity Rating Current Severity
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Brief Periods of increased energy/mild intensification; 3=Definite episodes of increased energy or activity

ElementDescription: Hypersexuality Severity Rating Current Severity
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Isolated, brief incidents of mildly inappropriate sexual behavior of questionable clinical significance; 3=Definite episodes of clearly inappropriate sexual behavior

ElementDescription: What is the child's BMI?
BMI category
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Underweight; 2=Normal Weight; 3=Overweight; 4=Obese

ElementDescription: Emaciation: Weight is proportionally lower than ideal for weight and height.
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Have you ever used diet pills to control your weight?
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Less than one time a week; 3=One or more times a week

ElementDescription: Have you ever taken laxatives to lose weight?
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Less than one time a week; 3=One or more times a week

ElementDescription: Have you ever taken water pills to lose weight?
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Less than one time a week; 3=One or more times a week

ElementDescription: Do you sometimes make yourself throw up?
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Less than one time a week; 3=One or more times a week

ElementDescription: Do you exercise a lot, more than was usual for you, in order to lose weight?
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Less than one time a week; 3=One or more times a week

ElementDescription: Did you have periods of at least 1 week in which you had nothing but liquids with no calories (teas, diet sodas, coffee, water)?
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Less than one time a week; 3=One or more times a week

ElementDescription: Eating Binges or Attacks
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Severity: Eating Binges or Attacks
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Subthreshold, Eating binges that occur less than once a week or have fewer than three associated features; 3=Threshold, eating binges once a week or more

ElementDescription: Eating much more rapidly than normal
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Eating until feeling uncomfortably full
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Eating large amounts of food when not physically hungry
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Eating alone because of being embarrassed
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Feeling disgusted, depressed or very guilty after overeating
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Disturbance in the way one's body weight or shape is experienced
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Severity: Disturbance in the way one's body weight or shape is experienced
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Subthreshold, Reports feels fat and is often bothered by these thoughts, although he/she is not fat by objective standard; 3=Threshold, Perceptions of self as fat are unaltered by objective evidence to the contrary

ElementDescription: A sense of lack of control over eating
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Severity: A sense of lack of control over eating
Notes: 0=No information; 1=Not Present; 2=Subthreshold, often can control urges to binge or can stop bingeing once it begins (at least 50% of the time); 3=Threshold, Sometimes can control urges to binge, usually cannot. Usually has difficulty stopping a binge once it begins.

ElementDescription: Self evaluation is unduly influenced by body shape and weight
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Evidence of CURRENT anorexia nervosa
Notes: 0=No; 1=Yes

ElementDescription: Anorexia Nervosa Severity  (Current)
Notes: 1=Mild; 2=Moderate; 3=Severe; 4=Extreme

ElementDescription: Bulimia Nervosa Severity  (Current)
Notes: 1=Mild; 2=Moderate; 3=Severe; 4=Extreme

ElementDescription: Binge Eating Disorder Severity  (Current)
Notes: 1=Mild; 2=Moderate; 3=Severe; 4=Extreme

ElementDescription: Number of suicide attempts, Past
Non-suicidal self injury Risk Level
Notes: 0=No risk (no NSSI); 1=Low (Has engaged in the behavior 1-4 times, never caused serious injury to self); 2=Moderate to High (Has engaged in the behavior 5 or more times and/or engaged in the behavior with significant injury to self [e.g., left scar, cut required stitches])

ElementDescription: Suicide Risk Level
Notes: 0=No risk (no suicidal thoughts); 1=Low (Modifiable risk factors, strong protective factors; thoughts of death, no plan, intent or behavior); 2=Moderate (Multiple risk factors, few protective factors; ideation with plan, but no intent or behavior); 3=High (Psychiatric diagnoses with severe symptoms, or acute precipitating event; protective factors not relevant; potentially lethal attempt or persistent ideation with strong intent or rehearsal)
